headline: Tankers Carrying Iraqi Oil Pass Through the Strait of Hormuz
summary: Tankers loaded with Iraqi oil passed through the Strait of Hormuz, Iraq's Ministry of Oil representative Salim al-Rikabi said on Tuesday.
why: Iraq is a major OPEC crude producer, and its exports depend heavily on the Strait of Hormuz, so transit of its cargoes matters for global oil supply.
